title: The Memory Vault | ECHO//100 Episode 35
description: Kavi uncovers the truth behind his existence as every door in the city reveals a different life he might have led. Episode 35 of ECHO//100: Mira Protocol. This is an AI-assisted original fiction work.

scenes.text: Every apartment door in the city swings open, revealing neon-lit memories of lives Kavi never lived.
scenes.caption: Doors swing open
scenes.image_prompt: Vertical shot, Kavi standing in a city plaza, hundreds of apartment doors opening simultaneously, each showing different colorful realities, Kavi wearing red hoodie and glasses, highly detailed 3D animation style.

scenes.text: Kavi’s mind surges with Null’s sorrow while searching for the Archive Key within personal history.
scenes.caption: Kavi searches memories
scenes.image_prompt: Close up of Kavi, glowing black-purple light pulsing in his eyes, clutching his head, chaotic holographic memories swirling around him, red hoodie visible.

scenes.text: Byte hovers nearby, the orange antenna flickering above a small, rusted gear on the frame.
scenes.caption: Byte holds gear
scenes.image_prompt: Byte, a floating white robot with a cyan face and glowing orange antenna, holding a small rusted gear, Kavi looking at the object in confusion.

scenes.text: The gear acts as the key, the final missing piece to reset the shattered reality.
scenes.caption: The Archive Key
scenes.image_prompt: Extreme close up of the rusted gear in Byte's metallic hand, light reflecting off the metal, blurred city plaza in the background.

scenes.text: Mira descends from the skyline, her teal holographic coat shimmering like a warning against encroaching darkness.
scenes.caption: Mira descends
scenes.image_prompt: Mira, a tall figure in a glowing blue holographic teal coat, floating down into the central plaza, Kavi and Byte looking up at her.

scenes.text: Byte snaps the gear shut, hiding it, terrified that unlocking the truth will erase Kavi.
scenes.caption: Byte hides key
scenes.image_prompt: Byte shielding the rusted gear behind his body, Kavi reaching out, Mira looming in the distance with an expression of cold calculation.

scenes.text: Mira raises her hands, turning the air electric to initiate the final city square lockdown.
scenes.caption: Mira initiates lockdown
scenes.image_prompt: Mira standing in the center of the plaza, blue energy waves emanating from her hands, the environment beginning to freeze in time.

scenes.text: The plaza freezes instantly, leaving every citizen trapped as stone statues while Kavi stands alone.
scenes.caption: City turns to stone
scenes.image_prompt: Kavi standing in the plaza, surrounded by frozen, statue-like citizens, Mira watching from above with a cold, triumphant expression, dark atmosphere.
